title: AI Gold Trading Bot – Live Verified Performance via Myfxbook
author: torvaboyy
selftext: Hi everyone, I'd like to share my AI-powered Gold trading bot that has been running on live accounts for the past 3 years. The bot focuses exclusively on Gold (XAUUSD) and uses a hedging-based strategy designed to manage risk and adapt to changing market conditions. Rather than relying on a single directional bias, it can maintain both long and short exposure when market conditions require it. Performance Live trading account Running for approximately 3 years Average monthly return around 8% All results are independently verifiable through Myfxbook Trades can be monitored in real time through MetaTrader 5 Transparency I understand that many trading bot claims online are difficult to trust. That's why I'm happy to share verified statistics, trading history, risk metrics, and account performance through Myfxbook so anyone can review the results independently. I also have a short MetaTrader 5 video showing the bot actively managing and executing trades in a live market environment. Risk Disclaimer Trading always involves risk, and past performance does not guarantee future results. The goal of the strategy is consistent long-term growth while maintaining strict risk management. I'm happy to answer questions about the strategy, performance metrics, risk management, or the technology behind the bot.
